changelog: 1.0.43: settings could not be saved after enabling extended mode (issue #44) or after applying a coordinate-search calibration — a re-enabled field failed the browser's validation silently; the page no longer blocks and the server keeps every value in range; titles pinned at the top (new episodes, next part of a saga) now respect the list filters; a new episode triggers a recomputation like other additions; "More like this" puts the next part first from the same sagas as the rest of the plugin (TMDb collections, name rule); free mix no longer favours library titles for brand-new accounts; deleted Jellyfin accounts are forgotten; a failed computation and an unreadable watch history now raise an alert; the first-play register is bounded.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
name: Reco+
overview: Personal recommendations (full history, abandoned titles, sagas, Seerr requests, extended mode).
